tasks.prompt:

tasks.title: Do we still need cinemas and theatres?
tasks.prompt:
Because people can now watch almost any film or show online, some argue that cinemas and theatres are no longer needed. Others believe these venues are still valuable, both for the economy and for culture.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

tasks.title: How a rain-shadow desert forms
tasks.prompt: The diagram explains how a rain-shadow desert is created.

figures.alt: Diagram in six stages: moist air from the ocean rises over a mountain range, forms clouds and rain on the windward slope, then sinks as dry, warm air and creates a desert inland.

stages.text: Warm, moist air moves in from the ocean.
The air meets a mountain range and is forced to rise.
As it rises, the air cools and water vapour condenses into clouds.
Heavy rain falls on the windward slope, where a forest grows.
The air, now dry, sinks down the leeward slope and warms up.
Hot, dry winds spread inland, where very little rain falls and a desert forms.
